title: Upper semicontinuity of closed-ball mass: {y : s ≤ μ(B̄_ρ(y))} is closed for a finite measure (parent step 4(i))
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, μ a finite measure on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra), ρ ∈ ℝ and s ∈ [0, ∞]. Then the set {y ∈ ℝ^P : s ≤ μ(B̄_ρ(y))} is closed, where B̄_ρ(y) = {z : |z − y| ≤ ρ} is the closed ball.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (ρ : ℝ) (s : ℝ≥0∞), IsClosed {y : Euclid P | s ≤ μ (closedBall y ρ)}
